Are you a morning bird and you love having your afternoons free? Then this is the perfect job for you! Start your day surrounded by the scent of fresh flowers. As an order picker at Royal FloraHolland in Aalsmeer, you make a difference every morning. You’ll work with a large, friendly team and make sure flowers and plants get to the right customer on time. Your shift starts at 6:00 AM, so you can enjoy your free afternoons after your work. Ideal if you enjoy active work and having your afternoons open!Every day is different. You smoothly drive an electric cart through the logistics hall. No license required, we teach you everything you need to know. You lift beautiful plants and flowers from your cart to the customer’s cart. You also check orders and help with other logistics tasks. You work in a nice flow and see the results of your work immediately.Do you want to be active, see results quickly, and work in an enthusiastic team? Join us! - You are fit and able to lift flower carts;

- You are at least 1.65 meters tall because of safety reasons
- You can start at 6:00 AM in Aalsmeer

- You are available at least 2 weekday mornings per week

- You can work for at least 7 months

- You speak good Dutch or English

- You can provide a certificate of good conduct (we pay for it)
- 
If you do not have a certificate of good conduct yet, you can request one (we will help you with this)
